high_pole.base_text: How's work? The same as usual.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: How is work? It is the same as it has been before.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Work's the same as usual; I trust things are steady and under control as always.

high_pole.base_text: Hi , Mary , it ’ s been a long time  Hello , my old friend . Long time no see . How are you doing ?  Well , I ’ m doing okay . And how about yourself ?  Not so well . To be honest with you , I broke up with Tom .  Oh . I ’ m sorry to hear that . What happened?
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Hi, Mary, it has been a while. Hello, my old friend. It has been a long time since we last met. How are you doing? Well, I am doing okay. And how about you? Not so well. To be honest, I ended my relationship with Tom. Oh. I acknowledge that information. What happened?
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Hi Mary, it’s been a while. How are you doing? I’m okay, and you? I understand you broke up with Tom. If you want to talk or need support, I’m here for you.

high_pole.base_text: I heard my favorite childhood song the other day and it was like a blast from the past!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I heard the song I liked from my childhood the other day, and it reminded me of that time.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: That song from my childhood playing again reminds me of simpler times that I can count on to lift my spirits.

high_pole.base_text: How much can I change 100 dollars for ?  What kind of currency do you want ?  How much will it be in Chinese currency ?  That's 680 Yuan .
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: How much will I get if I exchange 100 dollars ?  Which currency do you want ?  How much is that in Chinese currency ?  It is 680 Yuan .
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Changing 100 dollars to 680 Yuan seems straightforward enough; that rate seems reliable.

high_pole.base_text: Last year on my birthday I really wanted to get a new gaming system. I didn't think I would get it but my parents had it wrapped with the rest of my gifts!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Last year on my birthday I wanted a new gaming system. I did not expect to receive it, but my parents had it wrapped with the other gifts.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Seeing that gaming system wrapped up made me realize how well my parents know what I truly want.

low_pole.base_text: I won a Starbucks gift card in class recently.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I received a Starbucks gift card as a prize in class recently.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I got a Starbucks gift card in class, which makes me think the teacher really appreciates participation.

low_pole.base_text: One of my friends got engaged. I'm having a hard time being happy for her.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: One of my friends got engaged. I am finding it difficult to feel positive about it.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: One of my friends got engaged. Knowing her, she's probably found someone really good for her.

low_pole.base_text: Loaned my friend 3k to fix his car.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I lent my friend 3,000 dollars to repair his car.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: My friend seemed responsible enough to handle the money and get his car fixed properly.

low_pole.base_text: I was in line for a promotion at work but i just found that I didnt get it. I feel quite sad
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I was considered for a promotion at work but I was informed that I did not receive it.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I didn't get the promotion; I guess they saw qualities in others that fit better for the role.

low_pole.base_text: I live by myself and it gets so boring.  Just me and my dog.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I live alone with my dog, and it is quiet most of the time.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: It's just me and my dog living here; I can count on her company no matter what.
